Meet Villa Lithos. 🏛️

Built from local stone, perched above Porto Rafti Bay — this is where Greece reveals its quieter, more intimate side.

Not a resort. Not a hotel. A home — with an infinity pool, sauna, padel court, and one of the most beautiful views on the Attica coast.

45 minutes from Athens Airport. A world away from everything else. 🇬🇷
